lines.gurmukhi: ਮਥੇ ਵਾਲਿ ਪਛਾੜਿਅਨੁ ਜਮ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਮੁਤੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: mathe vaal pachhaaRian jam maarag mute ||
lines.translation: Grabbing them by the hair on their heads, the Lord throws them down, and leaves them on the path of Death.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੁਖਿ ਲਗੈ ਬਿਲਲਾਣਿਆ ਨਰਕਿ ਘੋਰਿ ਸੁਤੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: dukh lagai bilalaaniaa narak ghor sute ||
lines.translation: They cry out in pain, in the darkest of hells.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੰਠਿ ਲਾਇ ਦਾਸ ਰਖਿਅਨੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਸਤੇ ॥੨੦॥
lines.transliteration: ka(n)th laai daas rakhian naanak har sate ||20||
lines.translation: But hugging His slaves close to His Heart, O Nanak, the True Lord saves them. ||20||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਵਡਭਾਗੀਹੋ ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਪੂਰਨੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: raam japahu vadabhaageeho jal thal pooran soi ||
lines.translation: Meditate on the Lord, O fortunate ones; He is pervading the waters and the earth.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਧਿਆਇਐ ਬਿਘਨੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak naam dhiaaiai bighan na laagai koi ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and no misfortune shall strike you. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਬਿਘਨ ਤਿਸੁ ਲਾਗਤੇ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਨਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: kot bighan tis laagate jis no visarai naau ||
lines.translation: Millions of misfortunes block the way of one who forgets the Name of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਬਿਲਪਤੇ ਜਿਉ ਸੁੰਞੈ ਘਰਿ ਕਾਉ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak anadin bilapate jiu su(n)njai ghar kaau ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, like a crow in a deserted house, he cries out, night and day. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਪੂਰਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: simar simar daataar manorath pooriaa ||
lines.translation: Meditating, meditating in remembrance of the Great Giver, one's heart's desires are fulfilled.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਛ ਪੁੰਨੀ ਮਨਿ ਆਸ ਗਏ ਵਿਸੂਰਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: ichh pu(n)nee man aas gae visooriaa ||
lines.translation: The hopes and desires of the mind are realized, and sorrows are forgotten.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਾਇਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਭਾਲਦਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: paaiaa naam nidhaan jis no bhaaladaa ||
lines.translation: The treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is obtained; I have searched for it for so long.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਘਾਲਦਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jot milee sa(n)g jot rahiaa ghaaladaa ||
lines.translation: My light is merged into the Light, and my labors are over.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਆਨੰਦ ਵੁਠੇ ਤਿਤੁ ਘਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: sookh sahaj aana(n)d vuthe tit ghar ||
lines.translation: I abide in that house of peace, poise and bliss.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣ ਰਹੇ ਜਨਮੁ ਨ ਤਹਾ ਮਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: aavan jaan rahe janam na tahaa mar ||
lines.translation: My comings and goings have ended - there is no birth or death there.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਇਕੁ ਇਕੁ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: saahib sevak ik ik drisataaiaa ||
lines.translation: The Master and the servant have become one, with no sense of separation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੨੧॥੧॥੨॥ ਸੁਧੁ
lines.transliteration: gur prasaad naanak sach samaaiaa ||21||1||2|| sudh
lines.translation: By Guru's Grace, Nanak is absorbed in the True Lord. ||21||1||2||Sudh||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਗੂਜਰੀ ਭਗਤਾ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: raag goojaree bhagataa kee baanee ||
lines.translation: Raag Goojaree, The Words Of The Devotees:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸ੍ਰੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕਾ ਚਉਪਦਾ ਘਰੁ ੨ ਦੂਜਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: sree kabeer jeeu kaa chaupadaa ghar 2 doojaa ||
lines.translation: Chau-Padhay Of Kabeer Jee, Second House:

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਾਰਿ ਪਾਵ ਦੁਇ ਸਿੰਗ ਗੁੰਗ ਮੁਖ ਤਬ ਕੈਸੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਈਹੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: chaar paav dui si(n)g gu(n)g mukh tab kaise gun gaeehai ||
lines.translation: With four feet, two horns and a mute mouth, how could you sing the Praises of the Lord?

lines.gurmukhi: ਊਠਤ ਬੈਠਤ ਠੇਗਾ ਪਰਿਹੈ ਤਬ ਕਤ ਮੂਡ ਲੁਕਈਹੈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: oothat baithat thegaa parihai tab kat mood lukaeehai ||1||
lines.translation: Standing up and sitting down, the stick shall still fall on you, so where will you hide your head? ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਬੈਲ ਬਿਰਾਨੇ ਹੁਈਹੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: har bin bail biraane hueehai ||
lines.translation: Without the Lord, you are like a stray ox;

lines.gurmukhi: ਫਾਟੇ ਨਾਕਨ ਟੂਟੇ ਕਾਧਨ ਕੋਦਉ ਕੋ ਭੁਸੁ ਖਈਹੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: phaate naakan toote kaadhan kodau ko bhus khaeehai ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: with your nose torn, and your shoulders injured, you shall have only the straw of coarse grain to eat. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਰੋ ਦਿਨੁ ਡੋਲਤ ਬਨ ਮਹੀਆ ਅਜਹੁ ਨ ਪੇਟ ਅਘਈਹੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: saaro din dolat ban maheeaa ajahu na pet aghaeehai ||
lines.translation: All day long, you shall wander in the forest, and even then, your belly will not be full.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਭਗਤਨ ਕੋ ਕਹੋ ਨ ਮਾਨੋ ਕੀਓ ਅਪਨੋ ਪਈਹੈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: jan bhagatan ko kaho na maano keeo apano paeehai ||2||
lines.translation: You did not follow the advice of the humble devotees, and so you shall obtain the fruits of your actions. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੁਖ ਸੁਖ ਕਰਤ ਮਹਾ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਬੂਡੋ ਅਨਿਕ ਜੋਨਿ ਭਰਮਈਹੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: dukh sukh karat mahaa bhram boodo anik jon bharamaeehai ||
lines.translation: Enduring pleasure and pain, drowned in the great ocean of doubt, you shall wander in numerous reincarnations.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਤਨ ਜਨਮੁ ਖੋਇਓ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਬਿਸਰਿਓ ਇਹੁ ਅਉਸਰੁ ਕਤ ਪਈਹੈ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: ratan janam khoio prabh bisario ihu ausar kat paeehai ||3||
lines.translation: You have lost the jewel of human birth by forgetting God; when will you have such an opportunity again? ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਭ੍ਰਮਤ ਫਿਰਤ ਤੇਲਕ ਕੇ ਕਪਿ ਜਿਉ ਗਤਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਰੈਨਿ ਬਿਹਈਹੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhramat phirat telak ke kap jiu gat bin rain bihaeehai ||
lines.translation: You turn on the wheel of reincarnation, like an ox at the oil-press; the night of your life passes away without salvation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਮੂੰਡ ਧੁਨੇ ਪਛੁਤਈਹੈ ॥੪॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: kahat kabeer raam naam bin moo(n)d dhune pachhutaeehai ||4||1||
lines.translation: Says Kabeer, without the Name of the Lord, you shall pound your head, and regret and repent. ||4||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਘਰੁ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: goojaree ghar 3 ||
lines.translation: Goojaree, Third House:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੁਸਿ ਮੁਸਿ ਰੋਵੈ ਕਬੀਰ ਕੀ ਮਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: mus mus rovai kabeer kee maaee ||
lines.translation: Kabeer's mother sobs, cries and bewails

lines.gurmukhi: ਏ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਕੈਸੇ ਜੀਵਹਿ ਰਘੁਰਾਈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: e baarik kaise jeevahi raghuraaee ||1||
lines.translation: - O Lord, how will my grandchildren live? ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਨਨਾ ਬੁਨਨਾ ਸਭੁ ਤਜਿਓ ਹੈ ਕਬੀਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: tananaa bunanaa sabh tajio hai kabeer ||
lines.translation: Kabeer has given up all his spinning and weaving,

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਲਿਖਿ ਲੀਓ ਸਰੀਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: har kaa naam likh leeo sareer ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: and written the Name of the Lord on his body. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਤਾਗਾ ਬਾਹਉ ਬੇਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: jab lag taagaa baahau behee ||
lines.translation: As long as I pass the thread through the bobbin,

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਬ ਲਗੁ ਬਿਸਰੈ ਰਾਮੁ ਸਨੇਹੀ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: tab lag bisarai raam sanehee ||2||
lines.translation: I forget the Lord, my Beloved. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਓਛੀ ਮਤਿ ਮੇਰੀ ਜਾਤਿ ਜੁਲਾਹਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: ochhee mat meree jaat julaahaa ||
lines.translation: My intellect is lowly - I am a weaver by birth,

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਲਹਿਓ ਮੈ ਲਾਹਾ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: har kaa naam lahio mai laahaa ||3||
lines.translation: but I have earned the profit of the Name of the Lord. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: kahat kabeer sunahu meree maaee ||
lines.translation: Says Kabeer, listen, O my mother

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਮਰਾ ਇਨ ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ ਏਕੁ ਰਘੁਰਾਈ ॥੪॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: hamaraa in kaa daataa ek raghuraaee ||4||2||
lines.translation: - the Lord alone is the Provider, for me and my children. ||4||2||
